season.welcome.text: Welcome to The Big Eye hub! 🏠 Season {season} is about to begin.

survival.opening.text:
Surveyeval Mode activated
Eight contestants enter; synthetic players keep the board full after every robo eviction.

week.tribunal-start.text: Congrats all, you've just made it to tribunal. Your decision will select the winner.

week.day-start.text:
The Earth has made another spin. 
Day {day} has begun. Get ready.

survival.rules.text: [Rules] Public mode: OFF | Social mode: OFF | Endless days: ON | Double Elimination: possible

card.loh.text: The control is up for grabs - who will become Leader of the Hub?
card.loh.title: LOH Competition

card.democracia.text:
The players will elect the new Leader of the Hub by secret vote. 
Tie will trigger a ballotage.
card.democracia.title: DEMOCRACIA!

card.vox-immunity.text: One player can earn safety from the public vote.
card.vox-immunity.title: Immunity Competition

card.vox-final4-competition.text: No immunity is awarded today. Last place gets nominated; the other three each cast one secret vote.
card.vox-final4-competition.title: Final 4 Competition

loh.competition-start.text: The Leader of the Hub competition is underway! 🏆 Who will win control today?

loh.democracia-vote-start.text: 🗳️ Today's Leader of the Hub will be chosen by popular vote! Cast your votes now.

loh.winner.text: {winner} has won Leader of the Hub! 👑

loh.cupid-winners.text: {winner} won Leader of the Hub, making {partner} co-LOH under Cupid's Arrow! 👑💘

card.democracia-vote.text: The house votes by secret ballot to elect the Leader of the Hub.
card.democracia-vote.title: DEMOCRACIA!

democracia.winner.text: 🗳️ {winner} has been elected Leader of the Hub! 👑

democracia.co-leaders.text: 🗳️ The votes remain tied! {players} will BOTH serve as co-Leaders of the Hub! 👑👑

democracia.no-voters.text: ⚠️ No eligible voters available for ballotage. The winner is decided by the Big Eye gods!

democracia.ballotage.text: 🗳️ It's a tie between {players}! We go to BALLOTAGE! All other players must revote between the tied candidates. 🗳️

democracia.co-loh-social.text: {players} are now co-Leaders of the Hub! 👑👑 Alliances are already forming…

democracia.social.text:
Hubmates congratulate {winner}. Alliances are already forming… 💬 
Better stay alert!

democracia.vox-social.text: Everyone congratulates {winner} on winning immunity. The secret nomination conversations begin. 💬 You better mingle fast!

social.loh-congratulations.text:
Players congratulate {winner}. Alliances are already forming… 💬
Gotta stay alert!

card.nominations.text: The Leader of the Hub will reveal who is in danger.
card.nominations.title: Nomination Ceremony

card.double-eviction.text: Tonight, not one but two players will leave the game!
card.double-eviction.title: Double Elimination!

card.vox-nominations.text: Hubmates nominate privately in the Confessional.
card.vox-nominations.title: Secret Nominations

nominations.vox-confessional.text: Players are being called to the Confessional one by one to nominate in secret. 🗳️

nominations.co-loh-prompt.text: {leader}, as co-Leader of the Hub, you must nominate one houseguest for elimination. 🎯

public-save.intro.text: The final list of nominees today will be decided with the public's help. Better put your best clothes and smile at the cameras.

card.live-vote.text: The players will vote to eliminate.
card.live-vote.title: Live Elimination

vote.final-pitches.text: The nominated players give their last plea before voting begins.

vote.evicted.text: {evictee}, you have been eliminated from The Big Eye hub. 🚪

cupid.spell-broken.text: 💔 Four pairs have fallen. Cracks race through Cupid's hearts, the final arrow dissolves into light, and Cupid takes flight from The Big Eye couple's house. The rose glow fades: every survivor now plays alone. What the pairs felt - and what they did to each other - remains.

week.day-end.text:
Day {day} has come to an end.  Sun has set over the hub and the players enjoy golden hour. 
A new day begins soon… ✨

card.final3.text: Three players remain - the grand Finale battle begins.
card.final3.title: The Finale

card.vox-final3.text: One player will win immunity. The audience will decide who will join them in the Final 2.
card.vox-final3.title: Final 3

final3.part1-start.text:
Part One of the Finale is underway! 
All three players compete for a chance of being the final Leader of the Hub!

final3.part1-result.text: Part 1 result: {winner} wins and advances directly to Part 3! The other two players will compete in Part 2. 🏆

final3.part2-start.text: Part 2 of the Grand Finale is underway! The remaining two players battle to join the Part 1 winner in Part 3. 🏁

final3.part3-start.text: Part 3 of the Grand Finale is underway! {first} (Part 1 winner) vs {second} (Part 2 winner) — the winner becomes the Final Leader of the Hub! 🏁

final3.part3-result.text: Final 3 Part 3: {winner} wins and is crowned the Final Leader of the Hub! 👑

final3.part3-human-decision.text: {winner}, you must now eliminate either {nominees} to set the Final duo. 🎯

card.jury-announcement.text: The finalists will face the Tribunal. Ta-da-da-dum!
card.jury-announcement.title: Tribunal Votes

jury.cinematic.text: The Tribunal prepares to elect a winner.
